notes.title: Instructions for the AI
notes.hint: The agent follows these on every application, like rules. Describe how you want forms handled; your profile and resume already supply the facts.
notes.placeholder:
For example:
- Usual flow: open the job page, click Apply, create an account if needed, then fill in personal info, address, experience and questions.
- Prefer 'Apply with resume' or autofill options when offered, then check every field.
- Put my street address in Address Line 1 and leave Line 2 empty.
- Answer 'No' to optional marketing emails.

screening.title: Screening Answers
screening.hint: Answers to questions many applications ask. Leave the voluntary ones (gender, race, veteran, disability) empty to always decline to answer.
